name: codextent
description: Chrome extension: predict the output of C, C++, Java, Python and MySQL examples on learning sites, check it with Judge0, and learn the concepts.

scripts.test: node --test tests/templates.test.js tests/leetcode.test.js tests/quiz.test.js tests/runner.test.js tests/vault.test.js tests/compare.test.js tests/detector.test.js tests/judge0.test.js tests/stats.test.js tests/render.test.js tests/concepts.test.js tests/content.test.js tests/sites.test.js
scripts.package: node scripts/check-manifest.js && cd .. && zip -r codextent-extension.zip outputiq/manifest.json outputiq/src outputiq/icons
